source.title: Ballymena Observer, 9 June 1939, p. 10 ("Rural Council and Guardians: annual meetings held; chairmen re-elected"); Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 6 May 1939, p. 2 ("R.D.C. elections: retiring members unopposed"); Ballymena Observer, 5 May 1933, p. 10 ("Ballymena Rural Council: no contest"); Ballymena Observer, 14 July 1939, p. 4 ("Tribute to late member")
source.publisher: Ballymena Observer (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: no contest in the division (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 6 May 1939, p. 2); named as a sitting member of the new council early in the term (Ballymena Observer, 9 June 1939, p. 10: 'Mr. O'Donnell' named (M'Ateer substituted for him on the regional committee); Ballymena Observer, 14 July 1939, p. 4: the chairman regretted 'the death of Mr. Daniel O'Donnell, who represented the Toome Division for many years')

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, June 1939 (statutory day Thursday 1 June 1939): no contest. The Ballymena Observer of 5 May 1939, p. 10, lists the twelve divisions with one nomination, all 'old members of the Council', and the eleven in which 'the following retiring members were deemed re-elected'. Twenty divisions are corroborated by the council's meetings of June-September 1939 (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026); Ballyscullion, Drumanaway and Newtowncrommelin are taken from the deemed list. No party labels are printed. division inferred from the 1 June 1933 return (Daniel O'Donnell; Ballymena Observer, 5 May 1933, p. 10); the Ballymena Observer, 9 June 1939, p. 10 names the member as sitting for the new council (annual (first) meeting of the new Ballymena Rural Council, Wednesday 7 June 1939: members present, chairman, co-options, committees). He died on 1 July 1939, a month into the term (Ballymena Observer, 7 July 1939, p. 9). The vacancy was filled by co-option, not by election: 'New member co-opted for Toome' (Ballymena Rural Council, 5 August 1939); Mr. Alex. Higgins welcomed as a new member by the Guardians on 12 August 1939. Returned unopposed.
